reviews.title: Top Notch
reviews.comment: I was deciding between this GPU and RTX 5080, some minor performance differences more like 10 FPS gain for $500? I’m good lol This is a very powerful GPU, everything I throw at either 1440P or 4K Ultra no performance hiccups.  I get between 80-130fps! This GPU paired with a Ryzen 9 9950X3D + OLED TV + Resident Evil Requiem (free with GPU for purchase) ? = dream come true. P3.5
